title: ageratina simulans
intro: Ageratina simulans, commonly known as Mexican mountain mint, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. The health benefits of Mexican mountain mint include its potential to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. Its therapeutic actions include anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mexican mountain mint include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
